availability.cpuNotes: Desktop support follows current Opera package requirements.
availability.installMethod: Official installer, package repository, or app store.

foundation.codeLicense: Chromium open-source base with Opera proprietary UI and services

telemetry.note: Opera describes analytics and personalization controls in its privacy policy.

trackerBlocking.note: Opera includes an optional built-in ad blocker.

fingerprintingProtections.note: No broad hardened fingerprinting posture is claimed here.

privacy.privateWindows: Private windows remove local browsing records but do not anonymize traffic.

vpnOrProxy.note: Opera documents a browser VPN feature with scope and regional limitations.

manifestV2.note: Chromium compatibility depends on the release channel.

extensions.limitations: Chrome extension compatibility is subject to Chromium and Opera-specific behavior.

nativeContentBlocking.note: The ad blocker is a native optional feature.

verticalTabs.note: A native vertical tab strip shipped in Opera One in mid-2026.

workspaces.note: Workspaces are a first-party Opera feature for organising tabs by task.

profiles.note: Profiles or equivalent browser identities are available.

splitView.note: Native Split Screen supports two to four pages side by side.

sidebar.note: Opera's sidebar integrates messaging and browser tools.

commandPalette.note: A native command line covers browser commands and tab actions.

sync.note: Opera account sync supports selected browser data.

translation.note: Translation is available through browser features or services.

pwa.note: Progressive web apps are supported by the Chromium install flow.

iosEngine.note: Apple permits alternative engines in the EU and Japan under entitlement; no non-WebKit build ships in the App Store.

assistant.note: Opera AI provides a built-in assistant surface.

summarization.note: Opera AI documents page or multi-tab summarisation.

aiSearch.note: Opera AI documents AI-assisted answers in search or the address bar.

contentGeneration.note: Opera AI documents text or image generation.

modelChoice.note: Opera AI documents a choice of models or local model support.

aiPrivacyControls.note: AI privacy controls are not documented.

crossTabContext.note: Opera AI documents awareness of multiple tabs or history.

voiceMultimodal.note: Voice or image interaction is not documented.

dataSaver.note: No documented data-saving or compression mode.

mobileExtensions.note: Extension support on mobile is not documented.

downloadManager.note: A built-in download manager is not documented.

backgroundMedia.note: Background or picture-in-picture playback is not documented.

webPush.note: Web push support is not documented.
